name: Sorrento Deli Mart
notes: Restaurant's own domain is behind a bot-wall captcha (sgcaptcha redirect, 403 on every path tried). A 2023-03-21 Wayback snapshot of the site's own food-menu page has the same item names but prices 40-60% lower (e.g. Gyros $7.99 vs $12.49 now, Sorrento Special $8.99 vs $12.49 now) - too large and non-uniform a gap to be a delivery fee, read as staleness, so the 2023 page was not used as the price source. Priced from the restaurant's current DoorDash listing instead (schema.org Menu JSON-LD via page-service.doordash.com, dedup on the 'Most Ordered' carousel dropped). Address (Roselle St) confirmed in the DoorDash payload. A same-named 'Deli Mart' on Uber Eats (9210 Dowdy Dr, San Diego 92126) is a DIFFERENT business and was not used.
